mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate anticholinergic effects of benztropine and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk; benztropine's anticholinergic properties may reduce renal blood flow and worsen electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; assess for anticholinergic adverse effects; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antipsychotic agent if electrolyte abnormalities develop.
